description: This file defines the interface 'AuthAttributeBagInterface' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Authentication\Dto'. The interface specifies methods for managing a collection of attributes, including retrieval, modification, and checking existence of keys, as well as bulk operations.

classes.name: AuthAttributeBagInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing a collection of authentication attributes with methods for retrieving all attributes, keys, replacing, adding, getting, setting, checking existence, and removing attributes.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all attributes as an array.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns all keys of the attributes.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces current attributes with the provided array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds attributes from the provided array to the existing collection.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, or default if not present.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value for a specific key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the collection.
